buyFifoConvention: Within identical exchange timestamps, retain stable original complete-tape order as deterministic first-admitted FIFO bookkeeping. Preserve every original row, ID, price, quantity, timestamp and receipt. This is not finer venue chronology. Later receipts do not reorder accepted journal lots; fill-ID dedup/conflict checks remain. Partial disposal/redemption basis and period realized attribution, including cost-based exit floors, depend on this explicit convention. Aggregate purchase cash/shares, and fully disposed total profit are invariant. The known original order starts with both sides flat, has no accepted partial fill or intervening owned exit, and is held for actual settlement. No global historical cross-order chronology or venue-mandated FIFO rule is claimed.
